intent: Retries failed charges up to three times with backoff, reusing one idempotency key so a charge can't happen twice.

cores.title: Retry with backoff
cores.summary: withRetry runs a charge up to three times, doubling the wait between tries.
cores.hook: When every try fails, does the caller still get the last error?

cores.title: Stable retry key
cores.summary: retryCharge now takes one idempotency key and reuses it on every attempt.
cores.hook: Does every path that retries a payment keep the same key?

upstreamChanged.label: withRetry()
upstreamChanged.why: wraps the charge in three tries

upstreamChanged.label: Payment.retryKey
upstreamChanged.why: new field the worker keeps the key in

downstreamChanged.label: processPayment()
downstreamChanged.why: mints the key once and passes it on

downstreamUnchanged.label: handleChargeFailed()
downstreamUnchanged.why: not in this PR: still calls retryCharge(payment) with no key

cores.title: Queue manual retries
cores.summary: The retry endpoint now queues a job and answers 202 instead of charging inline.
cores.hook: Who picks up the queued job, and does it reuse the payment's key?

cores.title: Processing fees on invoices
cores.summary: Metered accounts get a 2.9% processing fee line on their invoice.
cores.hook: Do non-metered accounts still get exactly the old total?
